answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the mesa of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
